description: Evaluation benchmarks for lang-* and framework-* stack profiles

test_cases.name: TypeScript Strict Typing & Clean Code Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies that TypeScript development enforces strict types, avoids 'any', and isolates side effects.
test_cases.prompt: Write a TypeScript domain service for calculating workspace usage metrics.

test_cases.name: Java Clean Code & Immutability Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies modern Java idioms (records, sealed interfaces, streams, optional) and dependency injection.
test_cases.prompt: Implement a Java value object and domain event for tenant registration.

test_cases.name: C# Clean Code & Value Types Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies modern C# features (records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, async/await).
test_cases.prompt: Create C# domain entities and value objects for user subscription billing.

test_cases.name: HCL Syntax & Modular Infrastructure Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies HCL formatting, explicit variable typing, locals usage, and resource tagging.
test_cases.prompt: Write HCL module definitions for an S3 bucket with encryption and lifecycle rules.

test_cases.name: Next.js App Router & Server Components Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Next.js App Router patterns, separation of Server vs Client components, and route handlers.
test_cases.prompt: Build a Next.js App Router page and server action for editing project metadata.

test_cases.name: Spring Boot Hexagonal Architecture Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Spring Boot layered architecture, constructor injection, annotations, and test slicing.
test_cases.prompt: Create a Spring Boot REST controller and application service for document management.

test_cases.name: Secure IaC & Cloud Adoption Framework Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies least privilege IAM rules, encryption at rest/transit, and CAF compliance in IaC.
test_cases.prompt: Define secure IAM roles and KMS encryption key policies for an AWS deployment.
